rewrites._comment: Proxy the Render API onto this origin so the session cookie is first-party. vercel.app and onrender.com are both on the Public Suffix List, so a cookie set directly by the API would be third-party — Safari blocks those and Chrome is retiring them. Proxied here, the browser only ever talks to this domain. NOTE: /api/* is already taken by this project's own Vercel functions (sitemap, robots, seo), hence the separate /backend prefix. This rule is first so nothing below can claim it.
